fire: Families earning 150 to 250 percent of the median income qualify.

notes: Probe: ' x' 0.58, ' *' 0.52, ' ==' 0.64, ' to' between numbers 0.42; a date with slashes and plain prose 0.00-0.01. The - pole is Korean polite verb endings and digits.
